The '''KE-6b mine''' was a modified version of the [[KE-6 mine|KE-6 proximity mine]] manufactured by [[Golan Arms/Legends|Golan Arms]] and utilized by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="BF I guide" /> [[Imperial shock trooper/Legends|Imperial shock troopers]] were known to drop [[Proximity mine/Legends|proximity mines]] to effectively wipe out entire [[Squad/Legends|squads]] of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] soldiers and defend locations.<ref name="BF I">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The KE-6b mine is used by shock troopers in the ''[[Battlefront]]'' [[Star Wars video games|video game]] series.
